description: Start an AI Visibility Audit: measures how visible a brand is in AI assistant answers (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity) across a set of queries, with competitor benchmarking and recommendations. Costs 1 audit credit. Asynchronous — returns an audit_id immediately; audits take several minutes. Poll with get_brand_audit (detail "summary") until job_status is "completed", then fetch detail "full". Identical requests within 24h may return a cached audit.

competitors.description: Up to 5 competitor brand names to benchmark against.

domain.description: The brand's bare domain (e.g. "proweblook.com" — no scheme or path).

llms.description: Which LLM providers to test against (see the audit docs for supported values). Leave empty for all enabled providers.

queries.description: Specific user queries to test. Leave empty to have relevant queries auto-generated.

sample_size.description: Samples per query per LLM (1-10). Default 3.

name: run_brand_audit
